in_marathi.name: Dasu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ten, Dash, Servant, or Follower
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dasu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dasu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Das’, which means ‘ten’ or ‘dash’. In Hindu mythology, the term ‘Das’ is also used to describe a servant or a follower. Therefore, the name Dasu can be interpreted as ‘the servant of ten’ or ‘the follower of ten’. This name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Hindu tradition.
